newsitem.title: USA: Ohio soybean seedings at 76 percent complete.
newsitem.headline: Ohio soybean seedings at 76 percent complete.

text.p: Soybean seedings in Ohio as of Sunday stood at 76 percent complete, well above the 39 percent pace a year ago and just below the 78 percent average pace, according to the Ohio Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn conditions stood at 10 percent excellent, 46 percent good, 31 percent fair, 10 percent poor and three percent very poor.
Corn emergence jumped to 93 percent, well above 39 percent a year ago and above the 79 percent average pace.
Winter wheat headed reached 50 percent and the wheat crop was 11 percent excellent, 47 percent good, 29 percent fair, 11 percent poor and two percent very poor.
Topsoil moisture levels were 69 percent surplus and 31 percent adequate.
Pasture conditions were 10 percent excellent, 49 percent good, 30 percent fair, nine percent poor and two percent very poor.
